newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BALTICS- SOME PROGRESS MADE ON SEA BORDER DISPUTE.
newsitem.headline: BALTICS- SOME PROGRESS MADE ON SEA BORDER DISPUTE.

text.p: Lithuania's ministry of foreign affairs said on Friday that some progress had been made in the sea border dispute with neighbouring Latvia but no final agreement had been reached.
Lithuanian and Latvian delegations met in Vilnius on Thursday.

"If mineral deposits extend on both sides of the delimitation line and are exploitable from any side, neither state has the right to start exploitation...without the consent of the other state," the ministry said in a statement.
The next round of talks will take place in Latvia next month, the ministry said.
The row over the sea border, which cuts across a sea bed believed to contain significant oil reserves, has soured neighbours between the two neighbours.
